Subject: Request: VPC/on-prem architecture deep-dive — intake + scheduling

Hi Daniel & Lina,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. Customer team asked for a follow-up deep-dive to cover VPC connectivity, on-prem peering options, IAM integration, and the procurement path (PO/tax/invoicing). We want this to be a working session with your infra + security + procurement folks, so the AE/SE + security lead from our side will join.

Proposed goals for the call:
- Walk current network topology and constraints (VPN/Direct Connect equivalents)
- Validate firewall and egress requirements, IP ranges, and DNS routing
- Review IAM flow for service accounts and KMS/HSM expectations
- Outline procurement checklist and next steps for Dedicated/Private deployment

Candidate times (Pacific):
- Tue 2027-05-04 10:00 - 11:00
- Wed 2027-05-05 09:00 - 10:30
- Thu 2027-05-06 13:00 - 14:30

Attaching a short pre-call checklist and a tentative agenda. Mateo (SE) will lead the technical portion; Tessa will coordinate logistics. Copying procurement+security leads at Redwood as a heads-up. Please confirm who should be on the call from your side and which slot works best.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

redwood.com

Daniel — quick technical note ahead of Wed's session:

If you can attach the "current network diagram" as a PDF before EOD Tue 05/04 that would be great. Specific items that will speed the deep-dive:
- VPC CIDR blocks + any translation/NAT ranges
- Details on how DNS is resolved across on-prem and cloud (split-horizon?)
- Any existing IP allowlists (outbound) and proxy egress patterns

I'll prep a short slide with three deployment patterns (Direct Connect-style, VPN-multipath, and ephemeral tunneling) so we can map to your constraints live.

Also: if there's a network engineer who can share packet capture policies or eBPF constraints, bring them along — that materially affects our latency and TLS termination options.

—Mateo
